title: build validate outside a git checkout is an environment error: exit 3, nothing on stdout
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: Exit 3 is for what no build file can explain: a working folder outside any git checkout has no project (`jitso: <cwd> is not inside a git checkout`). Nothing is printed on stdout, orca is never called. A missing `jitso/jitso.yaml` is not such an error: every allowlist is then open.
